Inventory bags, stacks, capacity and atomic moves

Inventory is a bounded collection of stack/instance records. UI drag/drop requests a move; the backend commits ownership and capacity changes. Slot index alone is not a safe identity for a mutable item.

Scope and player interaction

Inventory is a bounded collection of stack/instance records. UI drag/drop requests a move; the backend commits ownership and capacity changes. Slot index alone is not a safe identity for a mutable item.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase09committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Closed → Loading → Ready → MovePending → CapacityError → ReconciliationRequired

WBP_Inventory observes results from URPGInventoryComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Inventory_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
InventoryRevision bigint; ContainerId UUID; SlotIndex 0..Capacity-1
Capacity=16 initially; expansions are durable entitlements
SlotPayload: Empty|Stack(DefinitionId,Quantity,BindingKey)|Instance(OwnedItemId)
Stack compatibility: same definition, binding and relevant variant; quantities <= MaxStack
ExpectedSourceItemId/StackRevision: optimistic check to prevent slot-replacement races
ReservedCapacity: only used by explicitly modeled pending/escrow operations; no invisible duplicate bag

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGInventoryComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_InventoryLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RequestMove(CommandId, SourceContainer, SourceSlot, ExpectedItem, DestinationSlot, Quantity) -> Moved|StaleItem|NoSpace
RequestSplitStack(CommandId, StackIdentity, Quantity, DestinationSlot) -> Split|InvalidQuantity|NoSpace
PreviewCapacity(PlannedRewards) -> Fits|NoSpace; UI hint, repeated authoritatively
ApplyInventorySnapshot(Revision, Slots) -> Updated|Stale; owner-only observer

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player drags a stable item view or requests split quantity; UI sends expected identity/revision and destination, then marks involved slots pending.
  2. Server checks owned session, request bounds, allowed container types and action state; backend locks character/container rows and resolves the actual current source.
  3. Validate stack compatibility, available quantity, destination capacity and binding. Simulate all deltas before applying any.
  4. Commit source/destination changes, inventory revision and receipt together. For a swap validate both sides; never remove the source before discovering the destination cannot accept it.
  5. Zone updates owner-only replicated projection; WBP_Inventory reconciles by identity/revision and restores pending focus after result.
  6. After timeout/reconnect, query receipt and snapshot. Do not recreate dragged items or trust locally cached slot contents.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create URPGInventoryComponent on PlayerState for owner-only in-zone inventory projection. Persistent rows remain in the backend.
  2. Create DA_Inventory_Default with 16 slots and explicit expansion rules; WBP_Inventory builds slots from capacity, not a fixed six-slot legacy panel.
  3. Add item-row/slot UMG widgets only as reusable presentational children; their OnDrop handlers call inventory requests, not SetArrayElem on the authoritative model.
  4. Seed Bag16 with one full ore stack, one partial stack, a sword instance and one final empty slot. Add a full-bag variation for capacity tests.
  5. Reopen loot, merchant, craft, gather and fishing owners to use the same authoritative capacity planner inside their transaction; do not each implement divergent stacking rules.

Reopen Phase09 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Character_A / Bag16 / Slot15Occupied. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Two grants competing for final slot -> only a valid serial result commits; no overflow bag.
Split zero, negative or more than owned -> InvalidQuantity, unchanged inventory.
Move request uses old item UUID after swap -> StaleItem, never moves the replacement.
Disconnect during drag -> no mutation unless a command committed; reconnection shows durable result.
UI refresh receives older revision -> ignore stale snapshot.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

16 slots and material MaxStack=99 are initial proposals. Optional bag expansion is a validated durable capacity change; shrinking capacity with occupied tail slots is prohibited.

Record before/after container revisions and reason codes. Provide keyboard/controller move/split actions so drag/drop is not required. Large inventories use list virtualization only when measured need warrants it.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
